title: S099 4.5.5 Messages with a Null Reverse-Path
parent_path: S099 4.5.5 Messages with a Null Reverse-Path

statements.subject: message
statements.description: Non-delivery notifications, Delivery Status Notifications (DSNs), and Message Disposition Notifications (MDNs) are required to be sent with a null reverse-path.

statements.subject: message
statements.description: All other types of messages (i.e., any message which is not required by a Standards-Track RFC to have a null reverse-path) SHOULD be sent with a valid, non-null reverse-path.
statements.guard_semantics: message.type != NDN & message.type != DSN & message.type != MDN

statements.subject: server
statements.description: Automated email processors SHOULD NOT reply to messages with a null reverse-path, and they SHOULD NOT add a non-null reverse-path, or change a null reverse-path to a non-null one, to such messages when forwarding.
statements.trigger: forward or reply to message with null reverse-path
